instruction:
Residential Block Model. Work in the opened OpenStudio application and build the model from scratch; there are no init_file inputs or local reference images for this case. Save result.osm in the task output folder.

Create 1 building story, 6 spaces and 6 thermal zones. Use these exact OS:Space names: Unit-1, Unit-2, Unit-3, Unit-4, Corridor and Stair. Every space must be assigned to a building story and a thermal zone, and each space must have more than 0.05 m2 of floor area.

Model the enclosure with 41 total OS:Surface objects, split into 6 floor surfaces, 6 roof/ceiling surfaces and 29 wall surfaces; the surface outside-boundary counts should be 6 Ground, 17 Outdoors and 18 Surface.

Do not add any subsurfaces or windows.

Do not include ideal-loads air systems. Include the required internal-load and zone system metadata: 6 zone HVAC equipment lists. Do not include dual-setpoint thermostats.

Set the geometry so the overall surface-geometry bounding box spans 24.00 m in X, 10.00 m in Y and 3.20 m in Z, each within +/-0.05 m, total floor surface area 200.00 m2 within +/-0.50 m2 and total exterior wall gross area 217.60 m2 within +/-0.50 m2.

Other model details may vary as long as the saved outputs satisfy these stated requirements.
